notes.title: Suppression Mode Revamp (RebellionSuppression Rebalance & Punishment Mode Added)
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38990473/a72b279f4f6174e0dc20d4ad09e37197e14eb44c.png[/img]
Last month’s Suppression Mode has been reborn stronger than ever.
It’s now divided into two distinct experiences: Rebellion Suppression Mode and Punishment Mode.

■Rebellion Suppression Mode: A refined 10-stage campaign based on the original rules. Quell the sparks of rebellion and defend your realm.  

■Punishment Mode: A survivor-style mode where you aim to conquer ever-higher stages, crushing endless waves of traitors.

We’ve lowered the overall difficulty and fixed previous AI issues, ensuring a more balanced and enjoyable gameplay experience.  
Thank you for your unwavering love for Merge & Blade. We look forward to your continued support!

notes.title: 'Suppression Mode' Update for the 2nd Anniversary Release
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38990473/a72b279f4f6174e0dc20d4ad09e37197e14eb44c.png[/img]
To celebrate the 2nd anniversary of Merge & Blade, we have updated the Suppression Mode, allowing you to battle in real-time while solving puzzles.

This mode offers an arcade-style experience reminiscent of classic puzzles like Puyo Puyo or Tetris's versus mode.

Enjoy the excitement of real-time puzzles, different from turn-based gameplay!

notes.title: July 16th, 2024 Hotfix Update Announcement
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38990473/f275b060219c2c9eab734f01ab2ed63f159a1bee.png[/img]

Dear game players,

In this latest hotfix update, the following improvements have been made:

■Addressed the issue with the Dictator's infinite level-up
■Fixed the game crash problem that occurred when certain boss monsters used their skills
■Resolved the malfunction of some challenge clear conditions
■Corrected the freezing bug in the Card Master feature
■Refined some user interface elements
■Adjusted the difficulty level of the 'Into the Abyss' mode

Additionally, the following bugs in Logright have been fixed:
■Resolved the issue with DLC characters not appearing
■Addressed the problem with the 100th stage ending not triggering
■Improved upgrade-related errors
■Corrected the clear reward bugs
■Fixed the reroll function bug
■Addressed issues with upgrade effect-related errors
This update has allowed us to provide a more stable and enhanced gaming experience.
We will continue to listen to the valuable feedback from our game players and make ongoing improvements.
Thank you.

notes.title: The second content update is finally here!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38990473/a72b279f4f6174e0dc20d4ad09e37197e14eb44c.png[/img]
Hello, everyone! 

The second content update is finally here!
This update provides 3 new roguelike characters, a whole new roguelike scenario, and achievements to unlock.

[h2] 3 new Roguelike Characters [/h2] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38990473/6a082ed208fb18ed4b6917297afa174fe5043785.gif[/img]
◾Revolutionist has a chance to become the highest-grade unit among those you have unlocked when merging farmers. Show the power of the people! 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38990473/c18fe25e5e8faafc9d5e3809057669005524ad07.gif[/img]
◾Bishop blesses the ally with the lowest HP. The units blessed by Bishop will restore HP and attack faster. However, Bishop doesn't care for herself, so be careful. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38990473/ce549e90839d7d53db71ca4b6c1490e0d8f3948c.gif[/img]
◾Vampire absorbs enemies' blood to restore its own HP. Why is Vampire on the human side? It's because it doesn't want its prey to disappear. 

[h2] Whole new Roguelike scenario - Into the Dark [/h2] 
◾Exploer the endless underground dungeon 
◾Each floor consists of 20 rounds, and if you win, you can proceed to the lower floor. 
◾If you lose continuously, you'll be driven out to the upper floor. 
◾As you descend the floors, you can gather clues about the monsters.  
◾Continue the challenging journey to get closer to the truth.  

Thanks a million for your feedback and support! If you let us know your thoughts on the game and this update, it will be really helpful to make the game better.   

We have started working on the next content update, including Roguelite mode! It would be very different from Roguelike mode.  
We’ll be back soon!

Hello, everyone!

The first huge update is finally here! This includes 8 new roguelike characters, 2 roguelike missions, new boss(please check who it is!) and new achievements are waiting for you! There are a lot of improvements as well.

Here's a peek at the next update: 

[h5]8 NEW ROGUELIKE CHARACTERS[/h5]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38990473/bc791e0974a4dc8cb02ae0a0640cb81684873693.gif[/img]
◾Card Master gains a card every 10 turns. The character's the best, except for the character's unusual fashion sense and love of 'duel'.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38990473/9b74335dfc5bd1ad9cc5ae2e90d49cfafb2d0b3f.gif[/img]
◾Thief has insanely fast attacks and uses no swaps when swapping places. The character also steals minerals when he attacks, so the character can help you unlock other content!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38990473/9e5aa6f297c48907db9eeedb12dd62a7f90f2227.gif[/img]
◾Dictator grows based on the sacrifices of the commoners. In the puzzle, if there are farmers and blacksmiths next to this character, the character will absorb them and level up.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38990473/faef79449942e77b9bd8cd43cf78e542caff7b90.gif[/img]
◾Berserker is a character whose HP and damage increases more and more each time getting hit, always hungry for battle.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38990473/6b0bb35f246af7fe82989a8884f4d50b785f59f7.gif[/img]
◾Explorer reduces the enemy's HP by 15% after recon, and restores HP of all allies in proportion to the number of recon. It's an open secret that his motto is 'Only hard research leads to success'.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38990473/781bde89b0aea00bddbc0f5aa37407c6da9c0e9d.gif[/img]
◾Prophet will automatically cast preview for free. As the number of previews you have increases, Prophet's health and attack power also increase. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38990473/8282b85f2f3dd69d87cfb6584199dea3682a9e50.gif[/img]
◾Puppy barks loudly at enemies! This is a great addition to the battle, as many enemies will stiffen after hearing his bark. By the way, this guy is nice and doesn't bite, so don't be scared.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38990473/30c3e08c9cf04591b9836c24005b29009ebaae5b.gif[/img]
◾Elf Archer always aim for one spot. Don't be mistaken if the monster looks like a hedgehog. Those are arrows shot by Elf Archer.

[h5]2 NEW ROUGELIKE MISSIONS[/h5]
◾Night of Battle: Defeat the lich castle with only one chance to assemble units.    
◾Mineral Mine: This mode provides a lot of minerals after every battle. Assemble the best units to mine minerals!

We just started to working on 3 new characters and 2 roguelike modes for the next update! If you have some thing to tell us, please feel free let us know here in the Steam forum, and also here:

Discord: https://discord.gg/rbNrc8MWpS

Twitter: https://twitter.com/magiccubegames

Youtube: https://www.youtube.com/user/MagicCubeGames


All your feedback and comment are so helpful to make the game better!

We'll be back soon to share the progression of the next update. Please stay tuned!
Thank you for playing!

notes.title: Full release date information
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

We're sorry to keep you waiting.
The full release is ready, it's going to release on Feb. 28th.

In the meantime, some work we've been trying for the first time ever took longer than expected and there was some health issue. but even with these, we should've shared progress of the game. We're sorry for not sharing you some news sooner.

Many issues have finally been solved and a few month ago a new team member has been joined as well.
The full release contains a new mode roguelike. There are some hero characters in the mode, it provides different fun than the campaign mode. And after the release, we will update free and paid unique hero characters in the roguelike mode every one or two months.

We'll always try to heard the community’s feedback, and make the game better with feedback.
Thanks a million for your support.
See you soon!

notes.title: Wo Long: Fallen Dynasty, Soul Hackers 2, F1 22, and Merge & Blade coming to Xbox Game Pass
notes.content:
Microsoft has announced a batch of games coming to Xbox Game Pass later this month and in early March.

The games are Atomic Heart, Wo Long: Fallen Dynasty, Soul Hackers 2, F1 22, and Merge & Blade.

Available today, is action-RPG Atomic Heart for cloud, console, and PC. This day-one Game Pass title is set in a "mad and sublime utopia" in 1955 known as Facility 3826. This Soviet Union research hub is where Polymer, a liquidized programmable module, was created. The device, called Thought, was also created here to integrate Polymer into the human body, allowing for interfacing with robots.
